summary: Streaming responses stop mid-completion; request eventually times out (no DONE event)
description:
Customer reports that for chat completions with streaming enabled, the event stream stops emitting chunks partway through. They do not receive a terminal DONE event. Client waits until its own timeout. Non-streaming mode completes (higher latency).

Notes:
- Dedicated cluster in eu-west.
- Customer uses our OpenAI-compat endpoint with stream=true.

Requested outcome:
Confirm whether this is a known issue and provide mitigation.
comments: Chloe Martin (Support): Asking for request IDs and whether they see any disconnect at TCP level. Their client shows the HTTP connection as still open.
Customer (via Support): Connection stays open; we just stop receiving data. It can stall after ~30-60 seconds.
Dev Patel (Eng Runtime): This matches known symptom from SUP-1842 (hosted) but may reproduce on dedicated as well. We added keepalive flush + unblock on backpressure in runtime 2.18.3.
Elliot Price (SRE): Dedicated eu-west cluster is on runtime 2.18.1. Recommend upgrade to 2.18.3.
Chloe Martin (Support): Coordinated maintenance window with customer; upgraded runtime to 2.18.3 on 2025-11-11.
Chloe Martin (Support): Customer confirms issue no longer observed post-upgrade. Closing ticket.
